entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SQLite: Polygon.Length translates to GLength, which returns 0 #39826
  • Migration lock with LockReleaseBehavior.Transaction doesn't prevent concurrent migrations since per-migration transactions #39824
    12.0.0

Closed

  • Migrations named with leading underscore #39828
  • WarningsConfiguration.ShouldUseSameServiceProvider boxes every entry #39819
    12.0-preview1
  • CoreOptionsExtension rebuilds the default WarningsConfiguration on every clone #39818
    12.0-preview1
  • ExpressionTreeFuncletizer.VisitMethodCall never returns its rented State arrays #39817
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0]: Bump SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle from 2.6.1 to 2.7.1 #39832
    area-infrastructure
  • Materialize null elements in JSON complex collections #39831
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39830
  • Fix SQLite Polygon.Length translation to compute perimeter via Boundary #39829
    community-contribution
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Azure.ResourceManager.CosmosDB and 3 others #39827
    area-infrastructure
  • Skip composed complex-type equality tests on the Windows Cosmos emulator #39825
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Fix Include for complex-type principal keys #39823

Merged

  • Bump SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle from 2.7.0 to 2.7.1 #39771
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 8.0.31 to 8.0.34 #39813
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Grpc.AspNetCore from 2.84.0 to 2.85.0 #39812
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Azure.Identity and 3 others #39808
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39807
  • [release/11.0] Make MinBy over subquery test deterministic #39805
    Servicing-approved, tell-mode
  • Compare WarningsConfiguration behaviors without boxing #39822
    community-contribution
  • Share the default WarningsConfiguration in CoreOptionsExtension #39821
    community-contribution
  • Return pooled argument states in funcletizer VisitMethodCall #39820
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Prototype bulk import API (DbSet.ImportFromAsync) (#27333) #39437
    community-contribution
  • Fix collection Contains normalization element type and overload matching (#39329) #39359
    community-contribution
  • Fix misleading exception messages when obtaining DbSet with entity type name (#31565) #39342
    community-contribution
  • Ignore constraint operations on tables being dropped in SQLite migrations (#39761) #39768
    community-contribution
  • Don't treat a filtered index as covering a foreign key index #39652
    community-contribution
  • Support null versus empty for owned JSON collections #39630
    community-contribution
  • Scaffold foreign keys whose column type differs from the principal key #39633
    community-contribution
  • Don't leave the context in a bad state when tracking an entity fails #39614
    community-contribution
  • Throw when same-named DbParameters are hard-coded in FromSql/SqlQuery SQL #39593
    breaking-change, community-contribution
  • Throw for proxy navigations whose accessors cannot be overridden #39591
    community-contribution
  • Place the model snapshot in --output-dir when it is specified #39565
    community-contribution
  • Translate primitive collections projected through set operations #39561
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Fix full-text catalog migration scaffolding #39787
  • Fix querying a TPC base type with a JSON complex property #39815
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Allow changing CLR type without SQL conversion #39786
  • Implement EF.Functions.IsJson #39749
    community-contribution
  • Do not use null when padding parameter collection buckets #39756
    community-contribution
  • Update StyleCop.Analyzers to 1.3.180 #39753
  • [release/11.0] Fix repeated full-text index migrations with UseLanguage #39752
  • [release/11.0] Preserve null compensation for JSON complex properties in left joins #39751
  • [release/11.0] Fix SQL Server JSON_CONTAINS type handling #39806
    Servicing-approved
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39796
  • Fix argument forwarding in metadata builders, paging and relational helpers #39799
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Don't validate JSON complex collections for identity resolution ordering #39816
  • Translate captured IQueryable variables to common table expressions #39803
    community-contribution
